bin.headline: This Monday, 3 August — recycling and garden waste.

eventsFootnote: Weekly regulars: yoga at Abbots Morton Village Hall on Mondays (9.45am; 5 and 26 October this month), Lenches Tennis Club cardio on Tuesdays (6.30pm), tai chi at Abbots Morton on Wednesdays (10am), and candlelight yoga at Rous Lench Village Hall on Thursdays (6.30pm). Sunday services continue across the ARCH benefice churches at Harvington, Rous Lench, Abbots Morton, Church Lench and Norton & Lenchwick.
